feeds.title: Conversational Italian!
feeds.description: Learn Italian with the blog Conversational Italian! Everything you need to know to enjoy your trip to Italy! Learn Italian phrases and important travel tips. Discover Italian culture, holidays in Italy and Italian food.

feeds.title: Italian Translation and Teaching
feeds.description: Blog by Chiara. This Blog offers Online Italian lessons, Italian culture, Italian translation.

feeds.title: Daily Italian Words Blog
feeds.description: We love languages and we'd love to help you learn Italian! On this website, you will find useful words, phrases, trivia and much more!

feeds.title: One World Italiano
feeds.description: Each week w talks about an event or tradition in Italy and introduce new vocabulary, idioms and grammar based on the topic with elementary, intermediate and advanced-level lessons. Since 2001 we have welcomed students from all over the world to our school in Cagliari, the historic main city on the beautiful island of Sardinia.

feeds.title: Dit is Italië » Italian language
feeds.description: Do you want to learn Italian? Quite right. Italian is a beautiful language with beautiful sounds and words. With these articles you will learn Italian! This is Italy is an Online Italy Magazine by and for Italy lovers. Here you will find everything about Italian regions, provinces, regions and cities, the landscape of Italy and the famous Italian lakes.

feeds.title: Italian Stories In Italian
feeds.description: This podcast is for all the lovers of the Italian language who think grammar is necessary but not sufficient. By listening to Barbara's stories in Italian you'll dive into the Italian world in order to learn Italian in an authentic way.

feeds.title: Italian Language Hub Blog
feeds.description: Learn all the fun things about Italy and Italians including language, food and culture. Find tutorials, free video lessons and lots of interesting materials. I'm Giulia. I want to share my knowledge with you and have you live and explore the world with one extra language in your pocket!

feeds.title: Studentessa Matta » Italian Language Learning, Tips, Motivation
feeds.description: Leading people who are crazy about Italy, giving them insights into language and culture, and helping them overcome learning doldrums, and frustrations. I'm Melissa, the Studentessa Matta - the crazy Italian language student - your guide to all things Italian!

feeds.title: Clozemaster Blog » Learn Italian
feeds.description: Clozemaster is a game to rapidly expand your vocabulary in another language. This is where we write about language learning as well as post useful resources. Stay up to date on the latest from Clozemaster on learning the Italian language.

feeds.title: Easitalian
feeds.description: Learn Italian Language Culture and Lifestyle with Easitalian Learn Italian online and improve your skills through high-quality resources. Find high-quality content that helps you learn the Italian language, culture, and lifestyle. This website is designed to help improve grammar, fluency, and overall proficiency and how to familiarize yourself with Italian and successfully master the language.

feeds.title: Parola del Giorno
feeds.description: Parola del Giorno is an Italian language newsletter that shares tips on Italian grammar and growing your Italian vocabulary by sharing with our readers unique words and expressions. We also feature posts on traveling to Italy, Italian cultural events, and other artistic, literary, and musical phenomenon.

feeds.title: Parlatè Blog
feeds.description: I'm Mirella. I'm Italian and have a bachelor's degree in linguistics. I also speak English, French and some German. Studying other languages and reading Italian and foreign literature is one of my hobbies. Here you will find language resources and updates on Italy, but also useful tips for traveling or living in Italy.

feeds.title: Online Italian Club
feeds.description: Online Italian Club is a free resource for learning Italian language full of exercise, listening tasks, articles plus easy Italian readers and online lessons.

feeds.title: Parla Italiano Blog
feeds.description: Read our Italian Language Blog at Parla Italiano, which includes details of our Book Club, achiving a higher level and basic phrases you need. Parla Italiano has been delivering successful Italian language training since 2006. The business was established by Laura Scaramella and has grown since then into a successful school centred on the work of a group of excellent teachers.

feeds.title: Italian Language Blog
feeds.description: My name is Jonathan Henry. I have been learning languages for a while now. But I have never attended formal classes for learning languages. Besides English, I also speak Spanish and Italian. And right now, I'm learning Hebrew and French. The Internet is full of resources for learning languages. So I made up my mind to learn Italian by myself and it has worked beyond expectations. Now that I know that this works, I would like to share with you those things that worked for me.

feeds.title: Instantly Italy Blog
feeds.description: My name is Cinzia and I'd love to become your Italian teacher, the one who helps you practice Italian conversation and grammar but who also gives you tips on how to make the most of your study time and shares with you the secrets for dealing with us weird Italians, offering you all the tools you need to enjoy Italy and its culture at best.

feeds.title: Italian Language Blog
feeds.description: This blog is about how to learn Italian language and culture with powerful, world-class language-learning technology to libraries, educational institutions, government organizations, corporations, and curious individuals.

feeds.title: FluentU Italian Blog
feeds.description: This Blog is about a new way to learn a language through authentic video content like music videos, movie trailers, news, and inspiring talks. With engaging and immersive content, we empower users to learn with fun videos exhibiting the diversity and vibrancy of Italian language & cultures.

feeds.title: Learn Italian Online
feeds.description: Italian Courses Online - Learn Italian Online with Skype and take lessons with native Italian speakers.

feeds.title: Your Italian Tutor
feeds.description: An Italian teacher based in Milan. Sonia teaches Italian with online lessons and in person.

feeds.title: Learn Italian Go
feeds.description: Learn Italian Go's mission is to deliver lessons, tips, exercises and tools to get the best out of your learning Italian journey. Perfect for beginners and intermediate learners, Learn Italian Go will give you the keys to understanding the beautiful Italian language and culture. Learning Italian will change your life in so many ways! Ready, set, let's go to Italy and talk to Italians!

feeds.title: Kappa Language School Blog
feeds.description: Explore Kappa Language School Blog featuring articles, videos, images and featured content about the Italian language and culture. Learn Italian through infographics and lessons. For 10 years, our Italian language school for foreigners has been helping students from all over the world to learn Italian L2 in a fast and fun way, through face-to-face Italian L2 lessons or online Italian courses.

feeds.title: Europass Italian Language School Blog
feeds.description: In our blog, we gather many tips and useful resources to learn Italian, as well as many curiosities about our Italian school. Europass is an Italian language school based in Florence, Italy, offering courses both online and on-site. We founded it almost 30 years ago so that we could have our own place: welcoming, open, where it was easy to connect with others and experience something new.

feeds.title: LingQ Blog » Learning Italian
feeds.description: You can learn how to speak Italian fast starting right here with these guides, courses and resources. LingQ is a vibrant community of passionate, enthusiastic language learners and native speaker tutors. The combination of awesome people and effective methodology make LingQ the best place to learn a language.

feeds.title: Italy Chronicles » Learn Italian
feeds.description: Italy Chronicle formerly Blog from Italy, has been chronicling life and goings on in Italy in English since 2010. Over the years, this site has evolved and is now, perhaps, more of a magazine than a blog. Italy Chronicles is a place to share and talk about life in Italy. Explore our tips and tricks of learning the beautiful language of Italy.

feeds.title: Think in Italian
feeds.description: Learning Italian can be difficult, especially if you're an adult with limited time to study. If you want to learn this beautiful new language, here you find plenty of online resources and courses available to help you along the way. Learn Italian online fast with lessons by a professional Italian tutor and serial language learner.

feeds.title: Lingua Lunga Italian Blog
feeds.description: Stories are the best and fun way to learn any language. Read these inspiring stories in Italian language for practising the real Italian language! Lingua Lunga is an online Italian school, that provides lessons to people who want to become fluent in Italian and learn the most romantic and melodic language in the world while discovering the culture behind it.

feeds.title: My Italian Lessons Blog
feeds.description: Italian blog to learn more about the Italian language and culture. Learn new Italian words and phrases with Parlando Italiano. We will tailor your Italian course depending on your specific needs so that you can make the most of your Italian lessons!

feeds.title: Italian Language Centre Blog
feeds.description: ILC exists to promote Italian language and culture in Brisbane and throughout Queensland. Our teachers are passionate about creating an engaging learning environment for students and Italian classes that deliver successful outcomes for all. We provide the authentic experience to learn Italian with social activities and events that ensure every student becomes part of the ILC community. Read more about certification courses and events in the blog.

feeds.title: Babilonia Blog
feeds.description: At Babilonia, we are proud to offer a range of Italian language courses to suit your various schedules and needs to STUDY ITALIAN: from individual and group courses to intensive courses and exam preparation. Explore the blog for more information on our courses, tips and more!

feeds.title: Cyber Italian Blog
feeds.description: This Blog offers course for beginner, intermediate and advanced students includes lessons and fun-learning activities with audio, pronunciation guides, video, exercises and exams, easy-to-understand grammar explanations and vocabulary. Learn Italian online with Maura Garau.

feeds.title: Smart Italian Learning Blog
feeds.description: I am Serena. I became a full-time Italian Language Coach when I decided to blend what I love to do: helping people to acquire and internalize new information in an efficient way and, what I am good at: foreign languages. I focus on teaching Italian because it's my lovely mother tongue and I believe that as a native coach, I can add real value to any Italian language course. Check out my articles on learning Italian language with smart learning method in the blog.

feeds.title: Corso Brancaleone
feeds.description: Welcome to Corso Brancaleone, a community for italian learners!

feeds.title: I Learn Italian
feeds.description: The blog is based on a communicative approach to teach Italian language. Lessons are interactive and enjoyable. Content is designed for learners of all ages with a primary focus to improve their skills and gain confidence. Blog by Antonio Lucicesare.

feeds.title: Centro Linguistico Italiano Dante Alighieri Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Italian culture and life style with interesting Blog articles. Centro Linguistico Italiano Dante Alighieri is a school of Italian language and culture for foreigners in Rome, offering courses and programs for all needs. Established in 1994, it is licensed by the Ministry of Education and recognized for the quality of education offered.

feeds.title: Joy of Languages Blog
feeds.description: This Blog mission is to bring out the fun in language learning. In love with foreign languages despite an irrational phobia of grammar books.My goal is to help people see the fun in language learning so that it becomes a joy and not a chore. Run by Katie Harris.
